mainEntity.name: What is a travel insurance plan for a vacation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A vacation travel insurance plan is just what it sounds like – a travel insurance plan to help cover your vacation. But it can be for more than just flights and hotel. Your prepaid and nonrefundable expenses for your vacation can be covered under your travel insurance plan in the event of certain unplanned events. Certain excursions, tickets, and even car rentals may be covered. Vacation should be when you’re the most relaxed; having a Travel Guard travel insurance plan can help you get there.

mainEntity.name: What does a travel insurance plan cover?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel Guard offers customizable travel insurance plans for your vacation. Look for a plan that has the coverage and benefit limits you need. Popular plan features include:

- Medical expense coverage

- Trip cancellation coverage

- Adventure sports bundle – if you’re planning extreme activities (optional add-on coverage available on certain plans)

- Travel inconvenience benefit – a one-time payment for inconveniences you encounter on your trip

- Emergency travel assistance – specialized representatives are available day or night for unexpected travel issues

- Baggage coverage

- Cancel for Any Reason (optional add-on coverage available on certain plans)

mainEntity.name: Do I need a vacation travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: No matter what type of vacation you’re planning, it’s smart to cover your travel investment. The unexpected can happen, even on vacation. So why put your travel plans and investment at risk? That’s why Travel Guard’s Deluxe , Preferred and Essential plans are smart options for your vacation travel insurance plan needs. Travel Guard plans offer optional add-ons that allow you to customize your plan to fit your specific needs. Plus, all of Travel Guard’s travel insurance plans come with access to our specially trained representatives for 24/7 emergency travel assistance

mainEntity.name: Which Travel Guard travel insurance plan is best for my vacation?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel Guard’s Preferred Plan is a great starting point for many travelers. This plan offers the most optional-add on coverages to customize your travel insurance plan for your specific travel needs – add optional Cancel For Any Reason or Travel Guard’s rental vehicle damage coverage to create the best plan for you.

No matter which Travel Guard insurance plan you choose, you’ll have access to our specially trained representatives for 24/7 emergency travel assistance .

mainEntity.name: When can I purchase a vacation travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text:
You can purchase a Travel Guard travel insurance plan at any point before you leave on your trip, but there are some additional advantages if you purchase early. Purchasing your travel insurance within 15 days of your initial trip deposit date (21 days on some policies) can qualify you for additional coverage like Travel Guard’s pre-existing medical conditions exclusion waiver .

For more detailed information on when to purchase and the advantages to booking early, check out our When Should I Buy Travel Insurance? article in our Education Center.
